quest.title: Help Mr. Page fill the library

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Welcome, welcome! I'm Mr. Page, and this is my <color=red>library</color>.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: It has become far too <color=red>popular</color>. Everybody at camp wants to borrow a book!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: The trouble is, nobody has <color=red>returned</color> a single one.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Just look at my shelves. They are completely <color=red>empty</color>!

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Barnaby, Tilly and Gus all know something about my <color=red>missing</color> books. Would you go and talk to them?

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Each of them needs a little help. Lend a hand, and the books will find their way <color=red>home</color>.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: There are still <color=red>gaps</color> on my shelves, I'm afraid.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: Keep helping Barnaby, Tilly and Gus, then come back and <color=red>tell</color> me all about it.

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: My goodness, the shelves are <color=red>full</color> again!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: You helped every one of my friends, and every book came back. I'm <color=red>delighted</color>!

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: <color=red>Thank you</color>. You're the best friend a library could have.

afterLines.speaker: Mr. Page
afterLines.text: The library is full again and I couldn't be <color=red>happier</color>. Pop in and read whenever you like!
